svg.text: Split power bus v3 — one DATA wire, five power groups (2+2+2+2+2)
One controller talks to all 10 servos on one wire · each pair of servos gets its own +12 V feed from the main power line
MAIN POWER LINE +12 V / GND · 16–18 AWG silicone · runs along the whole body, with slack at every joint
BLUE DATA wire is one continuous wire: controller → ID1 → … → ID10 · BLACK GND is continuous too · RED +12 V is cut (✕) before every inject board
every inject board: + 470 µF 25 V cap
IN from previous servo: GND → through · DATA → through · +V → cut ✕
IN from main line: +12 V (via 3 A fuse) → +V out · GND → GND out
OUT to first servo of the group: +12 V · GND · DATA (3-pin plug)
Result: each group is powered only by its own feed
1. Battery → fuse → key → main line: meter 12.x V
2. Set buck to 7.5 V, then connect the controller
3. Group 1 only (ID1–2) → test each servo by ID
4. Add groups 2 → 5 one at a time (check 12 V at each inject)
5. Slow sine gait; every servo reads ≥ 11.7 V
